hub_h1	Find out how to get the most from your contractor.
hub_lede	Tell us what matters to you.
choice_bids	I want to get competitive bids today
choice_save-money	I want to save money
choice_materials	I want the best materials
choice_warranties	I want the best warranties
choice_decisions	I want to make the right decisions
para_save-money	Many insurers offer a discount when you install impact-resistant roofing, and the amount varies by company and state. Ask yours what it offers. On Otter Quotes, contractors compete for your business, so they are more likely to include these upgrades for free or at discounted rates.
para_materials	Roofing and siding manufacturers make higher grade products with better resistance to wind, hail, and algae as well as insulated products that can make your home more comfortable. When contractors know they are competing for your business, they are more likely to include these upgrades for free or at discounted rates.
para_warranties	Some warranties are basically worthless, and some warranties mean the roof will probably out live you. Otter Quotes will help you learn the difference so you can assess the real value of what contractors offer you.
para_decisions	We will do our best to give you an unbiased opinion on the costs and benefits of every product that goes on your home so you can make informed decisions about what is best for you. Our goal isn't to sell you upgrades. It's to help you negotiate the best products you can for your home.
